description: This file contains utility functions for filesystem operations, including writing a file if it differs from current content, removing files, and removing directories, primarily used in build or post-build processes.

methods.name: writeTextFileIfChanged
methods.description: Writes a file only if its contents have changed, creating necessary directories beforehand.

methods.name: removeFileIfExists
methods.description: Removes a file if it exists, forcing removal.

methods.name: removePathIfExists
methods.description: Removes a directory or file recursively if it exists, forcing removal.
